docs.title: Purchasing, Receiving Goods, and Vendor Billing

sections.text: This chapter covers the end-to-end **Procure-to-Pay** workflow in ERPForAll—from raising a Request for Quotation (RFQ) and confirming a Purchase Order to receiving partial warehouse deliveries with backorders, generating a 3-way matched Vendor Bill, and processing vendor returns.

* **Purchase User**: Creates RFQs, manages product lines, and confirms orders within the company approval threshold. * **Purchase Administrator**: Approves orders exceeding the double-approval threshold (**Approve Order**), locks/unlocks confirmed orders, and configures Purchase Settings. * **Inventory User**: Validates incoming receipts and backorders under **Inventory → Operations → Receipts**. * **Accounting User**: Creates draft vendor bills from confirmed purchase orders, sets the **Bill Date**, posts bills to the Purchase journal, and registers vendor payments.

1. Navigate to **Purchase → Orders → Requests for Quotation** and click **New**. 2. Select the **Vendor** and check **Order Deadline**, **Expected Arrival**, **Currency**, and **Buyer**. 3. Under the **Products** tab, click **Add a line** and choose the product, **Quantity**, **Unit**, **Unit Price** (auto-filled when a Vendor Pricelist matches), and **Taxes**. 4. Click **Save**. ERPForAll assigns a purchase sequence number (for example, PO00023) and computes untaxed, tax, and grand totals.

1. Review vendor pricing and quantities on the RFQ and click **Confirm Order**. 2. If the order total is below the company approval threshold, it immediately becomes a **Purchase Order** and creates the incoming warehouse receipt (accessible from the **Receipt** smart button). 3. If the order reaches or exceeds your company's second-approval minimum (configured in **Purchase → Configuration → Settings**), the status moves to **To Approve** until a Purchase Administrator clicks **Approve Order**. ![A confirmed Purchase Order locks vendor and currency, displays its Purchase Order status, and links directly to the warehouse Receipt smart button.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/purchasing/confirmed-po.webp)

When goods arrive at the receiving dock: 1. Click the **Receipt** smart button on the confirmed Purchase Order (or open **Inventory → Operations → Receipts** and match **Source Document** to your PO number). 2. Under **Detailed Operations**, update the **Quantity / Done** count to match the physical delivery (for example, entering 6 when 10 units were ordered). 3. Click **Validate**. 4. When received quantity is less than planned demand, the **Remaining demand** dialog prompts you to: * **Create Backorder**: Generates a linked open receipt for the remaining 4 units (Back Order of Main/IN/...). * **Close Remaining Demand / No Backorder**: Closes the receipt at 6 units without expecting further delivery. 5. Return to the Purchase Order: **Received Qty** reflects 6, and once the backorder receipt is validated for the remaining 4 units, **Received Qty** updates to 10 and the billing status becomes **Waiting Bills**. ![When receiving fewer items than ordered, the Remaining demand dialog lets you create a linked backorder receipt for the balance.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/purchasing/backorder-dialog.webp)

1. On the confirmed Purchase Order with received quantities, click **Create Bill** (requires both Purchase and Accounting access rights). 2. ERPForAll opens a draft Vendor Bill populated with the received quantities, agreed PO prices, purchase taxes, and **Purchase Match** status (showing **Matched** when ordered, received, and billed quantities align under 3-Way Matching). 3. Enter the vendor's **Bill Date** and invoice reference number, review line amounts against the physical supplier invoice, and click **Confirm** to post the bill (BILL/...). 4. Click **Register Payment** to settle the bill and move its status to **PAID**. Back on the PO, **Billed Qty** updates and status becomes **Fully Billed**. ![A Vendor Bill drafted from a Purchase Order verifies ordered, received, and billed quantities with Purchase Match: Matched.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/purchasing/vendor-bill-3way-match.webp)

If received goods are damaged or rejected after validation: 1. Open the completed **Receipt** (Done) from the Purchase Order's **Receipt** smart button and click **Return**. 2. ERPForAll creates a reverse outgoing transfer (Return of Main/IN/... from Main/Stock to Vendors). 3. Verify or enter the return **Demand** quantity on the move line (for example, 1 unit), click **Confirm**, and click **Validate** to ship the returned items out of stock. 4. Record a matching **Vendor Refund / Credit Note** in Accounting if the vendor bill was already posted.

* **Cannot Confirm Draft Vendor Bill ("enter the bill date before confirming")**: Draft bills created from Purchase Orders require an explicit **Bill Date** matching the vendor's invoice before clicking **Confirm**. * **Warehouse Configuration Error on PO Confirmation**: Ensure the company has an active warehouse with a valid incoming operation type configured under **Inventory → Configuration → Operation Types**. * **Short-Receipt Billing**: When **Received Quantities** control is enabled, ERPForAll bills only the quantities actually validated on warehouse receipts. Validate pending backorders before billing the remainder.

docs.title: Purchase Agreements, Alternative RFQs, Pricelists, and Analytics

sections.text: Beyond single purchase orders, ERPForAll helps procurement teams standardize supplier pricing, run competitive tenders with Alternative RFQs, negotiate multi-period Blanket Agreements, enforce approval and 3-way match controls, and monitor spend through dynamic Purchase Reports.

Open **Purchase → Configuration → Settings** (requires Purchase Administrator / Settings Administration access) to configure company-wide procurement controls: * **Order Approval**: Require a manager's second approval (**Approve Order**) whenever a Purchase Order exceeds a configured monetary threshold (for example, $5,000). * **Lock Confirmed Orders**: Automatically lock confirmed POs against post-confirmation edits, or leave confirmed orders editable when buyers need flexibility. * **Three-Way Bill Matching**: Cross-check **Ordered**, **Received**, and **Billed** quantities on Vendor Bills so Accounts Payable sees at a glance whether a bill is **Matched** or requires exception review before payment. * **Days to Purchase**: Lead time buffer used by automated inventory replenishment to schedule RFQs ahead of stockouts. ![Purchase Settings centralizes approval thresholds, order locking, 3-way bill matching, and procurement lead times.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/purchasing/purchase-settings.webp)

1. Open **Purchase → Products → Vendor Pricelists** to view all negotiated supplier prices across products. 2. Click **New** to define a vendor price rule: * **Vendor** and **Product** (plus optional vendor product name/code). * **Minimum Quantity**: Volume tier threshold (for example, 1 unit vs. 50 units bulk pricing). * **Unit Price**, **Currency**, **Delivery Lead Time (days)**, and optional **Validity** dates. 3. Whenever a buyer selects that product on a new RFQ—or when Inventory Replenishment auto-generates an RFQ—ERPForAll selects the best matching vendor and unit price automatically. ![Vendor Pricelists store volume tiers, currencies, negotiated unit prices, and supplier delivery lead times.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/purchasing/vendor-pricelists.webp)

Use **Purchase Agreements** to lock in framework pricing and target quantities with a vendor over a contract period: 1. Open **Purchase → Orders → Purchase Agreements** and click **New**. 2. Choose the **Agreement Type** (*Blanket Order* or *Purchase Template*), select the **Vendor**, set contract dates, and add product lines with contracted quantities and unit prices. 3. Click **Save** and **Confirm** (assigning a sequence such as PA00001). 4. When you need a delivery call-off, create an RFQ linked to the agreement so contracted prices copy cleanly and ordered quantities accumulate against the agreement target. ![A confirmed Blanket Purchase Agreement tracks contracted vendor products, target quantities, and agreed unit prices.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/purchasing/purchase-agreement.webp)

To solicit competitive bids from multiple suppliers for the same requirement: 1. Open a draft RFQ (for example, PO00023) and click **Alternative** (or **Create Alternative**). 2. Select an **Alternative Vendor** belonging to the active company (or a shared company-agnostic contact) and confirm to generate a linked alternative RFQ (for example, PO00024). 3. Enter each vendor's quoted unit prices and lead times on their respective RFQs. 4. Click **Compare Product Lines** (or open the **Alternatives** comparison view) to compare vendor quotes line by line—including unit price, quantity, currency, and expected arrival—and choose the winning line or RFQ to confirm. ![Alternative RFQ comparison displays competing vendor quotes side by side so buyers can select the best offer before confirming.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/purchasing/compare-alternatives.webp)

Open **Purchase → Reporting** to monitor procurement performance across three built-in views: * **Purchase Report**: Dynamic hierarchical report summarizing total spend by vendor and purchase order with period filters, comparisons, drill-down, and PDF/XLSX export. * **Purchases by Product**: Tracks **Ordered**, **Received**, **Billed**, and **Untaxed** totals per product to highlight open receiving or billing backlogs. * **Purchase Pivot & Graph**: Interactive **List**, **Pivot**, and **Graph** analysis for slicing spend by vendor, buyer, product category, order date, or status. ![The Purchase Report rolls up total procurement spend by vendor and order with interactive filtering and export.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/purchasing/purchase-report.webp)

* **Cross-Company Error When Creating Alternative RFQ**: Ensure the selected **Alternative Vendor** belongs to the same active company (or has no restrictive company set on its contact record). * **Alternatives Smart Button Not Immediately Visible**: After closing the Alternative RFQ wizard, refresh or reopen the original RFQ if the **Alternatives** stat button has not updated in the header yet.
